## Search operators

Use operators to narrow a search.

| Operator | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `#tag` | Records with the tag |
| `owner:me` | Records you own |

## Saved searches

Save a search to run it again later.

```
# deals I own
owner:me
## not a heading
```

Saved searches appear under **My searches**.
